verdict.rationale: Independent evidence shows Claude models on two third-party evaluation surfaces. Artificial Analysis's independent comparison page lists current models (Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5) with its own intelligence and performance metrics, and the SWE-bench leaderboard includes many Claude entries. Missing for 10: evidence that the current flagship appears on SWE-bench (only 'Claude 4.5 Opus' is named there), and breadth beyond two independent evaluators.

support.subject: As a founder, the model shows up in independent third-party evaluations and leaderboards, so I am not relying only on vendor-run numbers

citations.quote: Artificial Analysis's independent model comparison page lists current Claude models by name, including "Claude Opus 5.5"
www.swebench.com's SWE-bench leaderboard HTML includes "Claude 4.5 Opus" and many other Claude entries.
